dct_creator_sm: Guéguen, Céline (Université de Sherbrooke). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2010-3440
dct_description_sm: The archived files contain 1) the R script to subtract the mass-to-charge ratios (m/z) of the blanks in the DOM samples, 2) the list of m/z detected in each DOM samples collected during the Horizon Glacé 2024 expedition, and 3) the intensities of the PARAFAC-validated components found in samples collected in winter 2024 in the Saguenay fjord.
dct_title_s: Optical and molecular characterization of dissolved organic matter in the Saguenay Fjord (winter 2024)
